title: Longer Run
briefing: 800 meters of RG-6 between the distribution point and the tap — that's 44 dB of cable loss before the 8 dB tap even enters the picture. The distribution point is pushing +50 dBmV. Size the line amp so the customer lands in the [5, 12] window. Service acceptance for this G.fast drop: the carrier must land in the window with CNR at or above 25 dB against the −35 dBmV noise floor.

card_lines: Strip: 6 mm dielectric exposed, 6 mm center conductor.
Braid: fold back evenly; no strand may cross the window.
Seat: dielectric flush with the mandrel face before compression.
Test: continuity AND short, every end, no exceptions.

options: Angled cut — close enough
Square cut with the cable cutter
Crush cut with pliers
steps.failure_mode: Crushed end — strands splayed before the strip.

steps.prompt: Strip the jacket to the card dimension.
options: Strip to the card: 6 mm dielectric, 6 mm conductor exposed
Strip long — extra conductor is harmless
Strip short and force the fit
Trim the braid flush at the strip
Leave the braid forward under the connector
Fold the braid back evenly over the jacket
steps.failure_mode: Braid folded forward — shield gap at the connector.

options: Leave the dielectric proud by 2 mm
Trim the dielectric flush with the braid fold
Shave the dielectric to half thickness
steps.failure_mode: Dielectric proud — the connector seats on foam, not braid.

options: Seat it most of the way — compression will close the gap
Twist it on until it feels tight
Push on until the dielectric is flush with the mandrel face
steps.failure_mode: Connector under-seated — intermittent contact under flex.

options: One full compression stroke with the compression tool
Two half strokes, checking between
Crimp it with the hex die instead
steps.failure_mode: Under-compressed — the connector walks off under pull.

options: Skip it; the compression looked right
Firm straight pull — the connector must not move
Twist while pulling to seat it harder
steps.failure_mode: No tug test — a loose end ships untested.

options: Glance at it under the bench light, no magnification
Skip — the tug test already passed
Check the window: braid even, no strand across the center
steps.failure_mode: Braid strand across the window — a short waiting for vibration.

options: Continuity + short test on the meter, both ends
Continuity only — shorts show up in service
Tone it out and call it tested
steps.failure_mode: No short test — a braid whisker ships live.

options: Label the distribution-point end only
Label both ends and dress the run with slack
Dress it tight — slack is sloppy
steps.failure_mode: Unlabeled end — the next tech guesses.
